status.description: Shared status vocabulary across every IBB (05-standards-contracts.md §10). 'partially completed' exists deliberately: an interface that cannot distinguish it from failure produces orphaned resources nobody owns.

result.description: Present when status is completed or partially completed. resourceId and operationalState are the baseline every capability returns; subnetId/cidrBlock/availabilityZone/routeTableId are subnet's capability-specific fields agreed per scaffold-ibb SKILL.md §1b.

subnetId.description: The provider's identifier for the created/modified subnet (e.g. an AWS subnet id or an Azure subnet resource id).

cidrBlock.description: The subnet's actual allocated CIDR block, as provisioned.

availabilityZone.description: The actual resolved zone identifier (e.g. "us-east-1a") the availabilityZoneIndex mapped to. Not returned for platforms/subnets that are zone-agnostic.

routeTableId.description: The identifier of the route table associated with this subnet.
